title: Unfair Trade Practice
description: Definition of Unfair Trade Practice under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a trade practice which, for the purpose of promoting the sale, use or supply of any goods or for the provision of any service, adopts any unfair method or unfair or deceptive practice including any of the following practices
content.plain_language: any business practice that deceives or misleads consumers to buy or use a product or service, including false advertising, hiding information, or making false promises
examples: a company advertising a product as 'new' when it's actually refurbished
a business making false claims about the quality of their services
non_examples: a company offering a genuine discount on a product
a business providing clear and accurate information about their services
